## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Stretford, United Kingdom. It starts at Barton Square, The Trafford Centre.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> At the LEGO® Ninjago™ City Adventure play feature, release your inner ninja across three stories of playtime fun! There's a climbing wall, a crisscross maze, a spiral slide of lights, and more. This interactive and imaginative area will make anyone a Spinjitzu Master in no time.
>
> There are over 1.5 million LEGO® bricks in MINILAND. See airships swoop and towers glow as the little land switches between day and night.
>
> Ready for the rides? On Kingdom Quest, buckle in and ride a chariot to rescue the captured princess. On Merlin's Apprentice, pedal through a LEGO® wizard's world of spells and sorcery.
>
> Build your own LEGO® rockets and explore weird alien landscapes, then take command at LEGO® mission control base. All this and more at Space Mission!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €29.91. It was rated 4.0 out of 5 from 46 ratings and 21 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
